gpt.text: Melisk travels to Utvara with Teysa, Crix and Uncle, who makes Teysa baroness, and later Teysa and Melisk bring Uncle's corpse into Pivlic's bar where Kos works. Teysa then discovers that Melisk has been erasing her memory and that Uncle's death and the deal with Niv-Mizzet were Obzedat schemes, so she breaks her oath.
Teysa rallies Utvara against the Cauldron and takes control of the Taj, who murder Melisk.
